Implement a comprehensive search operation that queries the todo_app_todos table with advanced filtering and sorting capabilities.

Query Strategy:
- Join with todo_app_todo_description_fields for text search in descriptions
- Join with todo_app_todo_completions for completion status filtering
- Support partial text matching on todo titles using trigram indexing
- Implement pagination with cursor-based or offset-based approach
- Apply user ownership filtering to ensure data isolation

Search Features:
- Text search across title and description fields
- Filter by completion status (all/complete/incomplete)
- Sort by creation date, start date, due date with direction
- Handle null dates appropriately in sorting
- Return summary information optimized for search results

Performance Considerations:
- Use database indexes on title (gin_trgm_ops) and description
- Implement efficient joins with proper indexing
- Consider search result caching for repeated queries
- Optimize pagination for large result sets
operations.description:
Perform a comprehensive search across the user's todo items with advanced filtering, sorting, and text matching capabilities.

This operation allows authenticated users to search through their personal todo collection using various criteria including text content, completion status, and date ranges. The search spans across todo titles and optional description fields, providing flexible search capabilities for efficient todo management.

The search supports partial text matching using trigram indexing for fuzzy search functionality. Users can filter results by completion status to focus on active tasks or review completed items. Advanced sorting options allow organizing results by creation date, start date, or due date in ascending or descending order.

Results are returned in paginated format with summary information optimized for search result displays. Each result includes essential todo information while maintaining efficient query performance even with large todo collections.

Security and privacy are maintained through strict user ownership validation, ensuring that users can only search through their own todo data. The operation integrates with the application's comprehensive privacy framework to prevent any cross-user data access.

This search functionality complements the standard todo list operations by providing targeted search capabilities for users with large todo collections or specific search requirements.
